# /crav1-feature-branch

[All skills](../skills.md) · Walkthrough: [From a draft spec to an accepted spec](../../from-draft-spec.md) · Playbook: [`SKILL.md`](../../../.cursor/skills/crav1/crav1-feature-branch/SKILL.md)

## Purpose

Create or check out feat/<slug> (one branch for spec+build) or spec/<slug> (specify-only; build later on feat/<slug>).

Prompt for `feat/<slug>` or specify-only `spec/<slug>`; no silent checkout, no push, no PR.

## Runs when

Brownfield: leave the default branch. Called by the user, [`/crav1-spark-to-spec`](crav1-spark-to-spec.md), [`/crav1-ideas-to-spec`](crav1-ideas-to-spec.md), [`/crav1-intake-to-specs`](crav1-intake-to-specs.md), [`/crav1-match-to-specs`](crav1-match-to-specs.md), [`/crav1-implement-task`](crav1-implement-task.md), [`/crav1-complete-task`](crav1-complete-task.md), [`/crav1-complete-tasks`](crav1-complete-tasks.md), and [`/crav1-complete-features`](crav1-complete-features.md).

## Reads

In short: Current branch, default branch, dirty tree.

Reads the current branch, the default branch, and whether the tree is dirty.

## Writes

In short: A local `feat/<slug>` or `spec/<slug>` checkout.

Writes a local checkout of `feat/<slug>` or `spec/<slug>` after the user picks.

## Does not

Leaves commits, push, and the pull request alone.

Limits and exceptions: skips the prompt when there is no repo, no commits, or the branch is already right. A dirty tree does not checkout.
